issues.message: 3 checklist items; please check for missing combined scenarios (e.g., what happens when Build experiments/pos-instrument-replay/tamper.mjs: read the frozen protocol.json tamperMatrix, and for each (class x manifestHandling) apply the mutation to an mkdtemp-isolated copy of a fresh small baseline, run verify via lib/instrument.mjs, and emit an identity-keyed verdict to tamper-verdicts.jsonl with {iterationId, class, manifestHandling, verifyStatus, verifyFlags (full vector), goldMetrics, fingerprintMatch (bool), disposition} + Assert H2 conformance: every fail-closed class yields status:fail AND fingerprintMatch=true; every acceptance-bucket + acknowledged-limitation entry yields status:pass AND fingerprintMatch=true; tamper.mjs exits nonzero on ANY mismatch are performed simultaneously?)

understanding still has 1 undigested unknowns: Whether re-running each class through the campaign harness reproduces the exact M0 fingerprints (expected yes; deterministic instrument) — verified by the run.
